title: ActQuant: Sub-4-bit Action-Guided Backbone Weight-Only Quantization for Vision-Language-Action Models
abstract: arXiv:2605.24011v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models exhibit remarkable action generation for embodied intelligence, but their heavy compute make deployment on edge platforms impractical. Aggressive, sub-4-bit weight quantization is the natural solution, yet existing post-training quantization (PTQ) methods suffer severe performance degradation in this regime. To address this, we introduce ActQuant, an action-guided mixed-precision PTQ framework that operates in two stages: (1) an inter-tensor bit allocator that assigns each weight matrix a single bit-width based on how much it contributes to predicting the agent's actions; (2) an intra-tensor scale optimizer tunes per-block quantization scales using action-aware curvature, so that dynamic range is concentrated on the weights most influential for control. translated_title: ActQuant：面向视觉-语言-动作模型的亚4比特动作引导主干网络仅权重量化
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在具身智能中展现出卓越的动作生成能力，但其庞大的计算量使其难以在边缘平台上部署。激进的亚4比特权重量化是自然而然的解决方案，然而现有的训练后量化（PTQ）方法在这种极端比特设置下会出现严重的性能下降。为解决这一问题，我们提出了ActQuant，一个动作引导的混合精度PTQ框架，它分两个阶段运行：(1) 张量间比特分配器，根据每个权重矩阵对预测智能体动作的贡献程度，为其分配单一的比特宽度；(2) 张量内尺度优化器，利用动作感知的曲率来调整逐块量化尺度，从而使动态范围集中在控制中最具影响力的权重上。为了充分发挥这种激进量化在设备端的优势，我们进一步提出了OmniModel.cpp，一个智能体化的模型转换流水线，可将……
tldr: ActQuant提出了一种动作引导的混合精度训练后量化框架，通过张量间比特分配和张量内尺度优化两阶段策略实现VLA模型的亚4比特仅权重量化，并配套OmniModel.cpp转换流水线支持设备端部署。
en_tdlr: ActQuant is an action-guided mixed-precision PTQ framework that achieves sub-4-bit weight-only quantization for VLA models via two-stage inter-tensor bit allocation and action-aware intra-tensor scale optimization, complemented by the OmniModel.cpp pipeline for on-device deployment.
